summary: REQ-34 timeline content update appears implemented in `frontend/src/anniversary/content.ts` with 7 milestones (2003–2020) plus 2 editable placeholder items. REQ-35 comment submission is partially implemented (frontend form + React Query hooks + backend add/list methods), but backend persistence and some validation requirements are not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist submitted comments across page refreshes/upgrades using stable storage (and add `backend/migration.mo` only if required).
missing_requirements.reason: `backend/main.mo` stores posts in a non-stable in-memory `let posts = List.empty<Post>();` with no `stable` variable, `preupgrade/postupgrade`, or migration module shown, so persistence across upgrades is not implemented in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend add-comment method includes basic validation such as non-empty fields (in addition to reasonable max lengths).
missing_requirements.reason: `addPost` only checks maximum lengths and does not validate non-empty/blank `name` or `comment` (e.g., `name == ""` or whitespace-only).

hallucinated_features.description: Renamed the domain concept to “posts” (usePosts/addPost/getPosts, Post type) rather than “comments”.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest specifies a visitor comment feature; the diff implements the same capability but under “posts” naming, which is not explicitly requested.
